items.title: Ship the single-player property game
items.notes: The browser game covers token selection, property decisions, end-of-game results, and restart.

items.title: Run the game on the Next.js App Router with TypeScript
items.notes: The application includes pnpm commands for development, type checking, production build, and start.

items.title: Preserve the original Weird Web October URLs
items.notes: The root page and statistics handlers have legacy rewrites under /2025/spooky.

items.title: Persist token unlocks in the browser
items.notes: A finished game can unlock new tokens for future runs in the same browser origin without Supabase.

items.title: Connect shared statistics to Supabase
items.notes: The app can submit and aggregate results through the existing wwo_2025_spooky_game_stats table when configured. A live environment is a separate verification item.

items.title: Document the project and contributor workflow
items.notes: The README links to the guides, agent instructions, and structured roadmap. The first inventory uses its creation date for earlier work without a recorded completion timestamp.

items.title: Check the original event URLs alongside the root routes
items.notes: Verified both production page URLs, the expected API methods, 405 on mismatched methods, and the 503 payloads without Supabase using pnpm test:routes after a production build.

items.title: Distinguish empty, unconfigured, and failed statistics
items.notes: The end-game sidebar distinguishes missing configuration, empty results, and retryable failure. Restart remains available.

items.title: Cover unavailable and empty statistics states
items.notes: Added request-state fixtures, checked missing configuration through production routes, and verified retry to the empty state during a simulated full game.

items.title: Make property decisions faster and explicit
items.notes: Exposed legal Buy, Pass, and Continue controls while preserving passive landing prompts. A vampire can continue when unable to buy but cannot dismiss an affordable purchase. Added action fixtures and verified a full round using fixed rolls in a simulated browser.

items.title: Explain faction rules and surface earned unlocks
items.notes: The picker names each faction and explains its rules and unlock conditions. End-game results tell the player when a new faction is earned.

items.title: Add regression coverage for browser token unlocks
items.notes: Added storage and qualifying-result fixtures. Verified an elf unlock on restart and after a fresh mount on the same simulated browser origin.
